scope: Reference-driven, biome-qualified procedural microforms; not georeferenced reproductions.

landmarks.geological_process: Quartz sandstone jointing and differential erosion into isolated towers and narrow valleys
landmarks.notes: Microforms only. Large real sandstone pillars require a noise/density treatment, not a surface decoration.

landmarks.place: Yunnan, Guizhou, Guangxi and Chongqing, China
landmarks.geological_process: Carbonate dissolution into pinnacle and cone/tower karst, depressions, caves and bridges
landmarks.notes: Calcite is a vanilla limestone visual approximation, not literal limestone stratigraphy.

landmarks.geological_process: Granitic bedrock outcrops, rocky river islands and riverine dryland transitions
landmarks.notes: Only next to existing source water on appropriate arid surfaces; river is not excavated.

landmarks.geological_process: Limestone plateaus over basement, insular arid vegetation and sheltered escarpments
landmarks.notes: Existing Socotra-inspired groves retained; endemic species conservation status is not asserted from appearance.

landmarks.geological_process: Basalt lava fields, fissures and slow moss colonization
landmarks.notes: Does not create active lava or destructive eruption.

landmarks.place: Global deep rocky continental slopes and seamounts
landmarks.geological_process: Exposed hard substrate and bottom currents enable cold-water coral and sponge habitats
landmarks.notes: Use depth and hard-bottom checks; no claim of actual geographic occurrence or threatened-status for a particular chunk.

landmarks.geological_process: Calcium-carbonate precipitation from flowing mineral-bearing water, creating stepped travertine rims and pools
landmarks.notes: Direct Genshin reference: Luhua Pool, confirmed by official Huanglong documentary. Worldgen adds only dry calcite-like rim microforms adjacent to existing source water: NO new ponds, dye, water, altered aquatic chemistry or terrace hydrology.

landmarks.geological_process: Karst tower and cone hill development coupled to the Li River's humid fluvial valley
landmarks.notes: Direct Genshin reference: Dihua Marsh, officially confirmed in Guilin documentary. Small river-adjacent calcite hill proxies only; do not carve river channels or pretend full tower karst.

landmarks.geological_process: Uplift, weathering and erosion of red continental sedimentary layers yielding cliffs, scarps, towers and ravines
landmarks.notes: Design analog for red-rock landscapes, NOT a confirmed Natlan direct reference. Three-color cliff microform; deep regional scarps require density functions.
